newsitem.title: GREECE: BROKER NIKIFOROS SUSPENDED FROM TRADE MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: BROKER NIKIFOROS SUSPENDED FROM TRADE MONDAY.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member Nikiforos Securities was suspended from trading 30 minutes before Monday's close because of what the firm said was a misunderstanding with a bourse guarantee fund auditor.

An officer of the firm told Reuters the incident had nothing to do with the Delta Securities settlement scandal which stopped all bourse trading recently but had to do with the firm's 1995 balance sheet.
It was unknown whether the brokerage would be allowed to trade on Tuesday. Its officers were scheduled to discuss the matter with capital market commission officials, the officer said.
He said Nikiforos Securities had upped its share capital to 300 million drachmas from 200 million after a 91 million loss in 1995 and the audit.
Nikiforos was on a list of 10 companies which the national economy ministry ordered audited last week after the Delta scandal broke.

Delta attempted to settle its account at the bourse clearing house with bad cheques worth 2.6 billion drachmas. Its three senior officers have been charged with fraud. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
